title: Aspen Search word-block call to action
description: A halftone field one and a half windows tall with a call to action set in huge all-caps word blocks: ink boxes spread across the top row (left edge, middle, right edge), a paper box for the long word beneath and a mint arrow square closing it. The words rise inside their boxes one after another as the phrase scrolls into view.
notes: height follows the window: 153svh, as on the original
media fills the field; empty it's a fixed halftone placeholder
type is sized in vw, so the word blocks keep their interlocking positions at every width; three short words + one long word fit best
CSS only; the rise is off under reduced motion
